en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4395 - It is narrated from Abdul Hamid ibn Awad, who reported from Abdul Khaliq, that he said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a previously married woman (thayyib) who arranges her own marriage proposal.
He replied: "She has full authority over herself. She may entrust her affairs to whomever she wishes, provided he is a suitable match, as long as she has been married to a husband prior to this."
